$comment: Residual cause census for the committed ACTIVITY oracle corpus, RE-CENSUSED by activity-style-defaults T7 after landing T1-T6 (per-element FontSize/LineThickness/RoundCorner resolution, the 1.4x->1.0x sizer advance, and the derived box height). The prior re-census was activity-element-granularity T4. Sibling of oracle/goldens/svg-sequence/diff-census.json. Every number is a pure function of the committed corpus at measuredAgainstCommit: each of the 268 status:"baseline" fixtures in diff-baseline.json is rendered through render-fixture-activity.ts#renderFixtureActivity with a DeterministicMeasurer and fixtureIncludeStore(), and compared with compareSvg(ours, golden, 'deterministic'). Paths are normalised by replacing every positional index with [], so svg/g[1]/rect[3]/@x and svg/g[1]/rect[7]/@x are one family. RANKED BY WEIGHT, NOT COUNT (D2 of the prior mission): a ranking by occurrence would misdirect the next mission the same way it did before this one existed.

descent.note: The activity-style-defaults headline. Before = 61677, the figure this file was pinned at by activity-element-granularity T4 (commit 53942ff7) and which this mission stated its exit bar against. After = this measurement, post T1-T6. FOURTEEN distinct fixtures rose at intermediate checkpoints and each was ADOPTED with a stated mechanism rather than silenced -- see plans/activity-style-defaults/decision-journal.md. The mechanisms are (a) a corrected box height exposing the separate, still-wrong LAYOUT_MARGIN, and (b) compareSvg pairing elements POSITIONALLY, so a correctly-added attribute costs one more unit on a pairing that was already structurally wrong (swimlane chrome, note draw order, nested-split childCount). None of those risers is a wrong VALUE.

exitBarFamilies.note: The two families the mission named as DIRECTLY attributable, restated against the figures its exit bar demanded.

geometryResidual.note: width/height still go BOTH WAYS -- no constant margin explains them -- but the SHAPE has moved. Width was wider=195 / narrower=73 / equal=0 and is now wider=168 / narrower=99 / equal=1; height was shorter=154 / taller=105 / equal=9 and is now shorter=198 / taller=69 / equal=1. The port is no longer systematically too BIG; it is now systematically too SHORT, which is LAYOUT_MARGIN = 12 against the jar's 16 (named in the T4 journal entry, filed as activity-canvas-margin). One fixture now matches each axis exactly, from zero before this mission.

childCountResidual.note: svg/g[][childCount]'s share of total weight fell from 91.6% (T0, pre-swap) to 39.9% -- the mission's headline descent. 206 of 268 fixtures still carry a root-group child-count mismatch (209 did pre-mission), now overwhelmingly attributable to the FOUR unrelated defects named in .agent-notes/aeg-T1-8-exceptions.md (embedded diagrams, note sizing, swimlane architecture, nested-split geometry, diamond font skinparams) plus each fixture's own missing-content residual, not to element vocabulary.

namedFamilies.finding: We resolve theme.colors.background to #FFFFFF where the jar resolves #1B1B1B, so the root style/background carries the wrong colour AND the background rect the jar paints under its own paintBackcolor guard (SvgGraphics.java:186-192) is correctly declined on our resolved white. The guard is faithful; its INPUT is wrong. Found by T5 while verifying the guard, handed to this census.
namedFamilies.correction: The T5 decision-journal entry names velodu-59-sada437 as a second instance of this family. It is NOT one: that fixture's golden is the jar's OWN graphical error page (green-on-black, PSystemError styling), it is pinned status:"jar-error" in diff-baseline.json, and it contributes no number to this census at all. Its #000000 background is the error page's, not a resolved theme. Verified at T6, not inherited. skinparam mode dark occurs on exactly ONE fixture in the whole 373-fixture corpus.

namedFamilies.finding: The only surviving root-attribute VALUE diff besides background. Source sets `skinparam preserveAspectRatio xMinYMid slice`; the jar emits that verbatim on the root, we emit the hardcoded default `none`. Not a missing attribute -- the document shell emits all 7 root attributes on all 268 fixtures (verified) -- an unported skinparam.

The only surviving svg/defs[1][childCount] diff, and the opposite of the pre-mission one: OUR defs is empty (0) and the JAR's holds 1 child. Source is `skinparam activity { BackgroundColor red-green }`; the jar expands the two-colour form into a <linearGradient> in defs and fills the rect with url(#...). We emit no gradient. Confirms the D6 change was right in general -- 267 of 268 goldens have an EMPTY defs, matching ours -- and isolates the one shape that needs it.
